scientific_integrity.limits: Finite computations corroborate but do not establish the all-graph quantifiers or limiting theorem.
scientific_integrity.provenance: Mathematical deductions with literature references; no independent validation claimed.

scientific_limitations: The inequality and limits concern the canonical orthogonal edge-coordinate cut and cycle projectors, not minimum-norm projections.
Only real finite connected simple unweighted base graphs with at least two vertices are covered.
Limits hold with the base graph fixed; intermediate \(\ell_p\) operator-norm formulas are not obtained.
A 1997 graph-products resistance paper could be compared only through its publicly accessible abstract.
title: Sharp clique-factor dominance and limiting norms for canonical graph Hodge projections
